Q6099.reason: In a lien-theory state (the majority view), a mortgage is only a lien and does not sever the joint tenancy, so the lien dies with the mortgagor and the survivor takes free of it.

Q6103.reason: Systemic sclerosis classically produces a beaked (pinched) nose and tight waxy skin; it is female-predominant, telangiectasia alone is not diagnostic, and arachnodactyly is a Marfan feature rather than sclerodactyly.

Q6111.reason: Under O'Brien, a content-neutral anti-littering ordinance may be applied to expressive conduct when it serves an important interest unrelated to suppressing the message.
